<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditReadiness" name="Company ready for external audit"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AuditFindings" name="Audit findings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FinalAuditRequest" name="Final audit request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CertificationDocuments" name="Certification documents"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CriteriaNotMet" name="Final audit criteria not met"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComplianceAudit">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Auditors" name="External auditors" processRef="Process_Auditors"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AuditScheduled" name="Audit schedule"
                      sourceRef="Task_ScheduleAudit" targetRef="Start_AuditScheduled"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AuditReadiness" name="Audit readiness"
                      sourceRef="Event_AuditReadiness" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReadiness"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AuditFindings" name="Audit findings"
                      sourceRef="Task_CommunicateFindings" targetRef="Event_ReceiveFindings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalAuditRequest" name="Final audit request"
                      sourceRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalAuditRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CertificationDocuments" name="Certification documents"
                      sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CriteriaNotMet" name="Final audit result"
                      sourceRef="Task_CommunicateCriteriaNotMet" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCriteriaNotMet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company compliance audit preparation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Company" name="Begin compliance audit process"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ScheduleAudit" name="Schedule compliance audit" messageRef="Message_AuditScheduled"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_AuditReadiness" name="Company ready for external audit">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AuditReadiness" messageRef="Message_AuditReadiness"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveFindings" name="Receive audit findings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveFindings" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestFinalAudit" name="Request final audit" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForFinalAuditOutcome" name="Wait for final audit outcome"
                            eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveDocuments" name="Receive certification documents">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveDocuments" messageRef="Message_CertificationDocuments"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveCriteriaNotMet" name="Receive result: criteria not met">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveCriteriaNotMet" messageRef="Message_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CertificationDocumentsReceived" name="Official documents received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CriteriaNotMet" name="Final audit criteria not met"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="Start_Company" targetRef="Task_ScheduleAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_ScheduleAudit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Event_AuditReadiness"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" sourceRef="Event_AuditReadiness" targetRef="Event_ReceiveFindings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveFindings" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_9" sourceRef="Task_RequestFinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForFinalAuditOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_10" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForFinalAuditOutcome" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_11" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForFinalAuditOutcome" targetRef="Event_ReceiveCriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_12" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveDocuments" targetRef="End_CertificationDocumentsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_13" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveCriteriaNotMet" targetRef="End_CriteriaNotMet"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Auditors" name="External audit and certification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AuditScheduled" name="Compliance audit scheduled">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AuditScheduled" messageRef="Message_AuditScheduled"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReadiness" name="Receive company audit readiness" messageRef="Message_AuditReadiness"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review company processes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyGaps" name="Identify gaps or issues"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CommunicateFindings" name="Communicate audit findings" messageRef="Message_AuditFindings"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFinalAuditRequest" name="Receive final audit request" messageRef="Message_FinalAuditRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductFinalAudit" name="Conduct final audit"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet" name="Are all criteria met?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueDocuments" name="Issue official documents" messageRef="Message_CertificationDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CommunicateCriteriaNotMet" name="Communicate that criteria are not met" messageRef="Message_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CertificationIssued" name="Certification documents issued"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalAuditCriteriaNotMet" name="Final audit criteria not met"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_1" sourceRef="Start_AuditScheduled" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReadiness"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReadiness" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_3" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_IdentifyGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_4" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="Task_CommunicateFindings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_5" sourceRef="Task_CommunicateFindings" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalAuditRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalAuditRequest" targetRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_7" sourceRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_8" name="All criteria met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allCriteriaMet</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_9" name="Criteria not met" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_CommunicateCriteriaNotMet">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not allCriteriaMet</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_10" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_11" sourceRef="Task_IssueDocuments" targetRef="End_CertificationIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Auditors_12" sourceRef="Task_CommunicateCriteriaNotMet" targetRef="End_FinalAuditCriteriaNotMet"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
